name: Option Wheel
description: Vertical curved picker wheel where options sit on an arc and blur and fade away from the selected one. Scroll, drag, click or use arrow keys to change the selection.
contents: List of text options laid out along a curved arc
Selected option highlighted with the active color and heavier font weight
behavior: Mouse wheel or touchpad moves the selection, one option per notch
Pointer drag moves the wheel and snaps to the nearest option on release
Clicking an option selects it, arrow keys step through options
Eased animation with exponential smoothing, opacity, blur and color fade by distance from selection
Optional tick sound on selection change, throttled to 70ms
Calls onChange with index and label

props.name: items
props.default: 12 music genres (Ambient, House, Techno, Jazz, Lo-Fi, Synthwave, Trance, Funk, Disco, Hip-Hop, Chillwave, Drum & Bass)

editableByProps: Options list, initial selection and change callback
Text and active colors, font size, row spacing
Curvature, tilt, blur, fade and minimum opacity
Wheel side (left or right), edge inset, smoothing speed
Looping, drag on or off, tick sound and volume

fixed: Root is h-full w-full, so the parent must have a defined height or it collapses
Wheel events on the component are captured with preventDefault, so the page does not scroll while hovering it
Drag and touch gestures are fully captured (touch-action none), so vertical page scroll by touch is blocked over the component
Options are single-line and not wrapped, long labels can clip at narrow widths, and the default 80px inset with 3rem text suits desktop, so reduce fontSize and inset on mobile
Font size uses rem units, scaling with the root font size
Uses Audio element only when soundUrl is set
Uses Tailwind arbitrary value classes and color-mix
